description: This file defines classes and enums for AES encryption and decryption within the Thunder::Crypto namespace, including methods for setting initialization vectors, key management, and encryption/decryption operations.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class providing AES encryption functionalities, including key setting, initialization vector management, and encryption.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class providing AES decryption functionalities, including key setting, initialization vector management, and decryption.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of AES mode used (e.g., ECB, CBC).

methods.name: InitialVector
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector used for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: InitialVector (setter)
methods.description: Sets the initialization vector for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption/decryption key with specified length.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data of specified length.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data of specified length.
